welcome.text: The festival starts soon! My kite has a torn wing and no string. Could you help me make it fly?
welcome.speaker: harpreet

firstHint.text: See the coloured patch paper and the spool on the bench? Use the paper on the kite first, then add thread. Drag or tap-to-combine both ways.
firstHint.speaker: harpreet

kiteTorn.text: Oh no, there’s a rip along the left wing. A little coloured paper should patch it.
kiteTorn.speaker: harpreet

kitePatched.text: That patch looks splendid! But we still need a tail of cotton thread before the kite can fly.
kitePatched.speaker: harpreet

kiteTied.text: Look at that! Good as new. Now let’s get some wind on the rooftop.
kiteTied.speaker: harpreet

kiteReadyInShop.text: Perfect! Patch and string are ready. The roof is through the door on the right.
kiteReadyInShop.speaker: harpreet

paperTaken.text: Bright orange repair paper! Tap the kite to attach it, or drag the paper from your pocket onto it.
paperTaken.speaker: harpreet

threadTaken.text: A strong cotton thread. We’ll tie it onto the kite after we patch the tear.
threadTaken.speaker: harpreet

needPatch.text: The thread will pull through that tear. Use the coloured patch paper first.
needPatch.speaker: harpreet

paperAlready.text: This kite is already patched. Now it needs thread.
paperAlready.speaker: harpreet

needString.text: Almost! The kite needs thread. There’s a spool on the bench.
needString.speaker: harpreet

stillBroken.text: Let’s fix the kite before heading up. The paper is on the left of the bench, and the spool is on the right.
stillBroken.speaker: harpreet

roofEarly.text: It’s breezy out here, but the kite still needs repairs. Go back down and finish it.
roofEarly.speaker: harpreet

roofWelcome.text: What a beautiful sky! Put the kite on the chalk circle, then check which way the wind is blowing.
roofWelcome.speaker: harpreet

roofKite.text: The kite feels lighter already. Tap the chalk circle to place it, or drag it there.
roofKite.speaker: harpreet

launchPadEmpty.text: The chalk circle marks the safest place to launch. Carry the repaired kite onto it.
launchPadEmpty.speaker: harpreet

launchPadReady.text: The kite is set! Now touch the weather vane and choose the gentler breeze.
launchPadReady.speaker: harpreet

windBefore.text: The vane is spinning. Place the repaired kite on the chalk circle first so we can test the wind.
windBefore.speaker: harpreet

windQuestion.text: The wind is changing. Which breeze should we use?
windQuestion.speaker: harpreet

badWind.text: WHOOSH! That gust nearly took my turban! Too strong for a little kite. Shall we try the gentle breeze?
badWind.speaker: harpreet

goodWind.text: That’s it. A soft, steady breeze! The kite is ready. Press LAUNCH!
goodWind.speaker: harpreet

launchBlocked.text: We need a mended, tied kite in the chalk circle and a gentle breeze before we launch.
launchBlocked.speaker: harpreet

skyIntro.text: Ready, Harpreet? One… two… three… LET GO!
skyIntro.speaker: harpreet

skyDone.text: Look at those colours! We did it. The whole neighbourhood can see our kite now!
skyDone.speaker: harpreet

character.text: Come on, partner! Let’s get this kite in the air together.
character.speaker: harpreet

bell.text: Ting! The little shop bell sounds just like the start of festival day.
bell.speaker: harpreet

cantCombine.text: Those don’t fit together just yet. Try the patch on the kite, then the cotton thread.
cantCombine.speaker: harpreet

badDrop.text: Try dropping the item on its destination — or select it and tap the target.
badDrop.speaker: harpreet
